lines.text: Dear <her>
I didn’t really know how to start this,
but I knew I wanted to make something for you,
something that feels a little more than just words.
It’s been <days> since we first started talking,
and somehow, in all that time,
you’ve become such an important part of my life.
You’ve made ordinary days feel lighter,
and the bad ones a lot easier to get through.
Somewhere between all the conversations,
the random moments,
and everything in between,
we’ve said “I love you” <ily> times,
but honestly, that still feels like a million too less.
And I’ve meant every single one of them.
Even then, it still never feels like enough
to explain how much you actually mean to me.
Some days, you used to say you were mean or not good enough,
but I love you, remember?
The good parts and the bad,
if it's you, I love it.
That is what makes you, you,
and I would not change that for anything.
If I could go back to the start,
I think I would still choose you every single time.
In every version of how things could have gone,
I would still end up here, with you.
Out of all the people in all the places I could have been,
I somehow ended up with you,
and I would not trade that for anything.
I do not know what the future looks like or how everything turns out,
but I do know this.
I want you in it.
Not just for now,
not just for the easy days,
but for all of it.
So I hope it is always you,
in this universe or another.
In every timeline, every lifetime, every little version of reality,
somehow I hope it leads me back to you.
Because even forever does not feel like it would be enough with you.
And if I had to do it all over again,
I would not change a thing,
as long as it still ends with you.
And today, out of all days,
I just hope you feel how special you really are.
Happy Birthday, babe
Forever yours,
<me>
